item.title: President Lee: "Price Stability Top Priority…Mobilize All Means to Manage Oil Supply Chain" (이 대통령 “물가안정 최우선…모든 수단 동원해 원유 공급망 관리”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 7th, "We must make price stability the top priority and mobilize all means to manage the supply chain for crude oil and key raw materials, as well as ensure supply safety for major items." (이재명 대통령이 7일 “물가안정을 최우선 과제로 삼되, 원유와 핵심 원자재에 대한 공급망 관리와 주요 품목 수급 안전에 모든 수단을 총동원할 때”라고 말했다.)

At a meeting of senior secretaries held at the presidential office, President Lee said, "Price pressure is increasing. Due to uncertainty over peace negotiations, oil prices have risen by over 20%, causing the rate of increase in consumer prices in April to widen compared to March." He added, "Thanks to the government's active management of prices, the increase is not as large as in major countries, but we cannot let our guard down." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관 회의에서 “물가 압력이 커지고 있다. 종전협상 불확실성 때문에 석유류 가격이 20% 넘게 오르면서 지난 4월 소비자물가 상승폭이 3월보다 확대됐다”며 “정부의 적극적인 물가관리 덕택으로 주요국에 비해 상승폭이 크진 않는데 그렇다고 마음을 놓을 수는 없다”고 말했다.)

According to the Consumer Price Trends for April released by the National Data Agency the previous day, the Consumer Price Index last month stood at 119.37 (2020=100), up 2.6% from a year earlier. This was the largest increase since July 2024 (2.6%). (국가데이터처가 전날 발표한 4월 소비자물가 동향을 보면, 지난달 소비자물가지수는 119.37(2020년=100)로 1년 전보다 2.6% 올랐다. 이는 2024년 7월(2.6%) 이후 최대 폭 상승이었다.)

"If price increases continue, the impact on the overall livelihood of the people will grow, consumer sentiment will contract, placing a heavy burden on the economic recovery trend," President Lee said. "With no end in sight for the war, the future of our economy will depend on how we overcome this crisis." (이 대통령은 “물가상승이 계속되면 민생 전반에 가해질 충격이 커지고, 소비 심리가 위축돼 경제 회복 흐름에 큰 부담이 된다”며 “전쟁이 언제까지 지속될지 알 수 없는 상황에서 위기를 어떻게 이겨내느냐에 따라 우리 경제의 미래가 달라질 것”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, regarding the Basic Act on Life and Safety, whose final passage by the National Assembly is imminent, President Lee said, "The presidential office and the government must meticulously prepare follow-up systems to ensure no disruptions in the implementation of the act." The Basic Act on Life and Safety, long sought by the families of the Sewol Ferry victims, includes provisions for the government to establish a comprehensive national plan every five years to guarantee the right to safety and to set, announce, and evaluate safety management standards in consideration of international norms. President Lee stated, "This law embodies our collective reflection and determination that citizens should never again lose their lives due to the state's absence," and added, "We must pool national resources to build a nation where everyone is safe." (아울러 이 대통령은 국회 본회의 처리를 앞둔 생명안전기본법과 관련해 “청와대와 정부는 법 시행에 차질이 없도록 후속제도 정비를 세심하게 해달라”고 말했다. 세월호 유가족들의 숙원이었던 생명안전기본법에는 정부가 5년마다 국가 차원의 안전권 보장에 관한 종합계획을 수립하고, 국제 기준 등을 고려해 안전관리 기준도 설정·공표·평가하도록 하는 내용 등이 담겼다. 이 대통령은 “이 법안에는 다시는 국가의 부재 때문에 국민이 생명을 잃어선 안 된다는 우리 모두의 반성과 다짐이 들어있다”며 “모두가 안전한 나라를 만드는 데 국가적 역량을 모아야 한다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Duck-soo's 8-Year Sentence Reduction: "50 Years of Public Service as a Reason? Shouldn't It Be an Aggravating Factor?" (8년 감형 한덕수…“50년 공직생활 공로? 가중 사유 아니냐”)
item.description:
Criticism is pouring in from political circles after former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo, who received a 23-year prison sentence in the first trial for his involvement in the December 3 martial law incident, had his sentence significantly reduced to 15 years in the appellate trial. (12·3 비상계엄에 가담한 혐의로 1심에서 징역 23년을 선고받은 한덕수 전 국무총리가 항소심에서 징역 15년을 선고받으며 형이 대폭 감형된 데 대해 정치권에서 비판이 쏟아지고 있다.)

Lee Sung-yoon, a Democratic Party lawmaker and former head of the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, posted on Facebook on the 7th: "The martial law trial division reduced Han Duck-soo's sentence to 15 years! They said, 'His 50 years of public service dedicated to the country is a merit'? That's an aggravating factor, not a mitigating one!" (서울중앙지검장 출신의 이성윤 더불어민주당 의원은 7일 페이스북에 “내란전담 재판부, 한덕수 징역 15년(으로) 감경 선고! ‘50년 공직 생활(에서) 국가에 헌신한 공로도 있다’고? (그건) 가중 사유지, 감경 사유는 아니다!”라고 올렸다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min also said on Facebook: "The reason for Han Duck-soo's sentence reduction: '50 years of public service'? Yoon Seok-youl also got a reduction for the same reason. If someone who has been a public official for 50 years did that, shouldn't it be an aggravated punishment, not a reduced one?" (박주민 민주당 의원도 페이스북에서 “한덕수 감형 사유 ‘50여년간 공직자로 봉직’? 윤석열도 그렇게 감형됐다. 50여년간 공직자로 있던 사람이 그랬으면, 감형이 아니라 가중처벌 해야 하는 거 아니냐”라고 말했다.)

On that day, the martial law trial division—Seoul High Court Criminal Division 12-1 (presiding judge Lee Seung-cheol)—convicted former Prime Minister Han on most of the major charges, similar to the first trial, but significantly reduced the sentence to 15 years. The court cited as mitigating factors that "although he engaged in important duties related to the insurrection, before the martial law declaration, he served as a public official for over 50 years, holding positions such as head of the Foreign and Trade Negotiation Office, head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy, and Prime Minister, and received numerous orders of merit, showing dedication to the country." (이날 내란전담재판부인 서울고법 형사12-1부(재판장 이승철)는 1심과 마찬가지로 한 전 총리의 주요 혐의 대부분을 유죄로 인정하면서도 1심 대비 형을 대폭 감형한 징역 15년을 선고했다. 재판부는 “비록 내란 중요임무에 종사하긴 했으나 비상계엄이 있기 전까지 50여년간 공직자로 봉직하는 동안 외교통상교섭본부장, 국무조정실장, 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 국무총리 등을 역임하며 다수 훈장을 수여받는 등 국가에 헌신해 온 공로가 있기도 하다”는 점 등을 감형 사유로 밝혔다. 선고 직후 한 전 총리 쪽은 상고 입장을 바로 밝혔다.)

Kang Joon-hyun, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, stated: "The sentence was reduced from 23 years in the first trial to 15 years, a reduction of a full 8 years. It's hard to accept," and "We express strong regret over the 15-year sentence in the appellate trial." Kang added: "We strongly condemn Han Duck-soo's behavior of claiming he 'cannot accept' the 15-year sentence without remorse and filing an appeal, even as a key accomplice in an insurrection. A co-conspirator who trampled on South Korea's constitutional order, receiving a sentence reduction and then persisting in claiming injustice—this is no longer about remorse but an insult to the public." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 “1심 징역 23년에서 15년으로 무려 8년이나 감형했다. 납득하기 어렵다”며 “항소심 징역 15년 선고에 강력한 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다. 강 대변인은 “내란 핵심공범으로서 반성하지 않고 징역 15년 형에 ‘도저히 납득할 수 없다’며 상고하겠다는 한덕수의 행태를 강력 규탄한다”며 “대한민국 헌정을 짓밟은 내란 공범이 감형까지 받아놓고도 억울하다고 버티는 모습은 반성을 넘어선 국민 모독”이라고 말했다.)

Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, also said at a briefing that day: "The reason for the reduction is absurd. '50 years of public service merit,' 'unclear leading role,' 'consideration of age.' Are these words fit for a courtroom judging an insurrectionist? Is it even appropriate to cite 'public service merit' for someone who destroyed the constitution?" He criticized it as "a judicial disaster that collapsed the 23-year sentence of the first trial and showed leniency to an insurrectionist." (손솔 진보당 수석대변인도 이날 브리핑에서 “(감형) 이유가 기가 막힌다. ‘50년 공직 공로’, ‘적극적 주도 여부 불명확’, ‘연령 고려’. 이것이 내란범을 단죄하는 법정에서 나올 말이냐. 헌법을 파괴한 자에게 ‘공직 공로’를 따지는 것이 가당키나 하냐”라며 “1심의 징역 23년을 스스로 무너뜨리며 내란범에게 선처를 베푼 ‘사법 참사’”라고 비판했다.)

Lim Myung-hee, spokesperson for the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, stated that day: "This is a tragedy that must never be repeated. Old age and a career of dedication as a public official should not be grounds for sentence reduction. Many citizens will wonder how far the severity of the law extends." (임명희 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 “다시는 반복되어선 안 될 비극으로 고령의 나이, 공직자로서 국가에 헌신한 경력이 감형 사유가 되어서는 안 된다”며 “법의 엄중함은 어디까지인지 많은 국민들이 궁금해할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking News] Constitutional Amendment Bill Tabled at National Assembly Plenary Session… People Power Party Declines to Attend as Party Policy ([속보] 개헌안 국회 본회의 상정…국민의힘 당론 불참)
item.description:
A constitutional amendment bill, the first in 39 years, was tabled at a plenary session of the National Assembly on the 7th. Lawmakers from the People Power Party did not enter the chamber. (39년 만의 헌법 개정안이 7일 국회 본회의에 상정됐다. 국민의힘 의원들은 회의장에 들어오지 않았다.)

This amendment bill includes the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Protests and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the Constitution, as well as provisions such as: introducing parliamentary approval for the president's declaration of martial law, upgrading the National Assembly's right to request lifting of martial law to a right to lift it, and a clause mandating balanced regional development. (이번 개헌안은 헌법 전문에 부마민주항쟁 및 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 수록하고, △대통령의 비상계엄 선포에 대한 국회 승인권 도입 △국회 계엄해제요구권을 계엄해제권으로 격상 △지역균형발전 의무 명시 조항 등을 담고 있다.)

Earlier, in a meeting of ruling and opposition floor leaders presided over by National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Democratic Party of Korea floor leader Han Byung-do pointed out, "They call this an election-oriented constitutional amendment, but I simply cannot understand how this is related to elections." People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok reiterated his party's opposition stance, stating, "Pushing forward with only some provisions that can be agreed upon is a patchwork amendment, and forcing a vote in the National Assembly to hold a referendum in line with election dates is a rushed process." (앞서, 우원식 국회의장 주재로 열린 여야 원내대표 회동에서 한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 “선거용 (개헌)이라고 하는데, 이것이 선거와 무슨 관련인지 도대체 이해할 수 없다”고 지적했다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 “일부 합의할 수 있는 내용만 갖고 하겠다는 것은 누더기 개헌이고, 선거 날짜에 맞춰 국민투표를 하기 위해 국회에서 표결해야 한다는 건 졸속”이라며 반대 당론 유지 의사를 거듭 밝혔다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Constitutional Amendment Vote Fails as All People Power Party Members Boycott...Woo Won-shik Says “Will Hold Revote Tomorrow” (개헌안 표결, 국힘 전원 불참에 무산…우원식 “내일 재표결”)
item.description:
The first constitutional amendment bill in 39 years, submitted to the National Assembly’s plenary session on the 7th, was declared “invalid for voting” due to a lack of a quorum for the vote. National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik announced that a plenary session will be held at 2 PM on the 8th to vote on the amendment bill again. (7일 국회 본회의에 상정된 39년 만의 헌법 개정안이 의결 정족수 부족으로 ‘투표 불성립’이 선언됐다. 우원식 국회의장은 8일 오후 2시 본회의를 열어 개정안에 대한 표결을 다시 할 것이라고 밝혔다.)

The quorum needed to pass the constitutional amendment is 191 members, two-thirds of the total registered lawmakers, but all members of the People Power Party (PPP), which adopted a party line opposing the amendment, boycotted the vote. A total of 178 lawmakers from six parties—including the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—participated in the vote. Speaker Woo stated, “I deeply apologize to the people that a result of invalidity has come out of the National Assembly before even proceeding to a national referendum.” (개헌안 통과에 필요한 의결 정족수는 재적 의원 3분의 2인 191명인데, 반대 당론을 채택한 국민의힘 의원 전원이 불참했다. 더불어민주당, 조국혁신당, 진보당, 개혁신당, 기본소득당, 사회민주당 등 6개 정당 의원 178명 의원이 투표에 참여했다. 우 의장은 “국민투표로 가기도 전에 국회에서 불성립 결과가 나온 것에 대해 국민 여러분께 대단히 송구하다”고 말했다. )

This constitutional amendment includes enshrining the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble, introducing a requirement for National Assembly approval for the president’s declaration of martial law, upgrading the National Assembly’s right to request the lifting of martial law to a right to lift it, and a clause stipulating the duty to promote balanced regional development. (이번 개헌안은 헌법 전문에 부마민주항쟁 및 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 수록하고, △대통령의 비상계엄 선포에 대한 국회 승인권 도입 △국회 계엄해제요구권을 계엄해제권으로 격상 △지역균형발전 의무 명시 조항 등을 담고 있다.)

After announcing the plan for a revote, Speaker Woo said, “After experiencing great pain and chaos from the December 3 martial law, the aim is to amend the constitution to prevent such an event from happening again. If you do not participate in the vote, you will become historical accomplices abetting and aiding the December 3 martial law,” urging PPP lawmakers to seriously consider participating in the vote. (우 의장은 재투표 방침을 밝힌 뒤  “12·3 비상계엄으로 큰 고통과 혼란을 겪고 나서 다신 그런 일이 벌어지지 않도록 헌법을 고치자는 것인데, 투표에 참여하지 않으면 (12·3 비상계엄에) 동조, 방조한 역사의 죄인이 될 것”이라며 국민의힘 의원들에게 투표 참여를 진지하게 고민해 달라고 했다. )

Earlier, PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk held an on-site supreme council meeting in front of the presidential office and said, “The constitutional amendment the Democratic Party is trying to pass is a tactical trick to extend the dictatorship of Lee Jae-myung.” (앞서, 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 청와대 앞에서 현장 최고위원회의를 열어 “민주당이 통과시키겠다는 개헌안은 이재명 독재 연장을 위한 정략적 술수”라고 말했다.)

item.title: PPP's Chung Jin-suk "Withdraws Candidacy Application"…Extinguishing the 'Yoon Again' Flames (국힘 정진석 “공천 신청 철회”…윤 어게인 논란 ‘급한 불’ 끄기)
item.description:
Chung Jin-suk, former presidential chief of staff, who had applied for the People Power Party (PPP) nomination for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province, withdrew his candidacy application on the 7th. (충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 공천을 신청한 정진석 전 대통령 비서실장이 7일 공천 신청을 철회했다.)

On the same day, Chung posted on Facebook, saying, "While it is painful for me, it will also be very painful for the party," and added, "If my candidacy harms party unity or weakens our party's momentum to stop the rampant rule of immense power, I will halt that path." (정 전 실장은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “저도 고통이지만 당도 많이 고통스러울 것”이라며 “저의 출마가 당의 결속을 해치거나, 거대 권력의 독주를 막아낼 우리 당의 동력을 약화시킨다면 그 길을 멈추겠다”고 했다.)

He stated, "I will return as an ordinary party member and serve in the ranks," and "I will dedicate myself from the lowest position for the victory of conservative patriotic forces." He further added, "The only alternative to stop the Democratic Party's rampage is the People Power Party. I hope the people will look at us once more, saying, 'Even if we dislike it, one more time,'" and "Please rally support for the People Power Party so we can check the arrogant regime of Lee Jae-myung and its thick-skinned dictatorship." (그는 “이름 없는 평당원으로 돌아가 백의종군하겠다”며 “보수 애국세력의 승리를 위해 가장 낮은 곳에서 헌신하겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “민주당 폭주를 멈춰 세울 유일대안은 국민의힘뿐이다. 국민께서 ‘미워도 다시 한번’ 쳐다봐 주시기 바란다”며 “오만한 이재명 정권의 후안독재를 견제할 수 있도록 국민의힘에 힘을 모아주시기 바란다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, it was reported that Park Deok-heum, chairman of the PPP's nomination management committee, met with Chung, who is his in-law, on the same day to persuade him not to run. Park told reporters, "I met with former Chief Chung at lunch and explained in detail the party's difficult situation and strongly persuaded him." He added, "As he listened, he replied, 'I'll think about it,' and left." (앞서 박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 이날 사돈 관계인 정 전 실장을 만나 불출마를 설득했다고 한다. 박 위원장은 이날 기자들과 만나 “점심에 정 전 실장을 만나서 지금 당이 어려운 입장을 자세히 설명하고 설득을 많이 했다”며 “(정 전 실장은) 듣고 계시다가 ‘생각을 좀 하겠다’고 답하고 갔다”고 전했다.)

Within the party, there were mounting concerns that nominating Chung Jin-suk, the final chief of staff under former President Yoon Suk Yeol, would provide fuel for the ruling party's 'Yoon Again nomination' attacks, negatively affecting the entire local elections. Kim Tae-heum, a candidate for South Chungcheong Province governor, even mentioned the possibility of leaving the party and running as an independent if Chung were nominated. (당내에서는 윤석열 전 대통령의 마지막 비서실장인 정진석 전 실장을 공천할 경우 여당의 ‘윤어게인 공천’ 공세에 빌미를 제공해 지방선거 전체에 악영향을 줄 거라는 우려가 빗발쳤다. 김태흠 충남지사 후보는 정 전 실장을 공천할 경우 탈당 후 무소속 출마 가능성도 언급했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: NIS: North Korea’s Constitution Clearly Marks Division into ‘Two States’…No Hostile Language Against South (국정원 “북 헌법, ‘두 국가’ 단절 분명히…대남 적대 문구는 일절 없어”)
item.description:
The National Intelligence Service (NIS) has reported on North Korea’s revised constitution, stating that “while it clearly establishes two states, it also shows a reduction in hostility.” (국가정보원이 북한 개정 헌법에 대해 “두 국가를 분명히 했지만, 적대성을 줄여나간 모습을 보였다”고 보고했다.)

The NIS made this assessment during a closed-door plenary session of the National Assembly’s Intelligence Committee on the 7th, as revealed by the committee’s bipartisan secretaries, Park Sun-won of the Democratic Party of Korea and Lee Seong-kwon of the People Power Party, in a briefing. The NIS noted, “Although there is a phrase stating ‘non-infringement of inviolability shall not be tolerated’ regarding the areas bordering the Republic of Korea, there is no hostile language toward the South at all,” and analyzed, “Through this constitutional revision, North Korea clearly emphasizes severance with the Republic of Korea, but the focus is on maintaining the status quo and managing the situation rather than adopting an offensive stance toward the South.” (국정원은 7일 국회 정보위원회 비공개 전체회의에서 이렇게 평가했다고 정보위 여야 간사인 박선원 더불어민주당, 이성권 국민의힘 의원이 브리핑에서 밝혔다. 국정원은 “대한민국과 접해있는 영역에 대한 ‘불가침성 침해를 용납하지 않는다’는 문구는 있지만, 대남 적대 문구는 일절 없었다”며 “이번 헌법 개정을 통해 대한민국과 단절을 분명히 하지만, 대한민국에 대한 공세적 의미보다 현상유지 및 상황 관리에 방점을 뒀다”고 분석했다.)

The NIS stated that through this constitutional revision, North Korea has “further consolidated one-man rule.” This is because the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission is defined as the supreme leader and head of state, placed first among constitutional bodies. Previously, the Supreme People’s Assembly was positioned before the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission. (국정원은 북한이 이번 개헌을 통해 “1인 통치가 더욱 공고화됐다”고 밝혔다. 국무위원장을 최고영도자·국가수반으로 정의하고, 헌법기구 첫번째 자리에 배치했다는 이유에서다. 기존에는 최고인민회의가 국무위원장 앞에 배치돼 있었다.)

The NIS also cited as evidence the extensive authority granted to the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, including nuclear force command, and the removal of checks on the Chairman. Deputy Director Lee Jong-suk said, “We view North Korea’s explicit declaration to the outside world that it will not abandon nuclear weapons as the specification of nuclear force command,” according to lawmaker Lee. Earlier, in the 1st session of the 15th Supreme People’s Assembly in March, North Korea implemented a constitutional revision establishing territorial clauses and deleting unification-related clauses. (국정원은 국무위원장에게 핵무력 지휘권 등 권한이 광범위하게 부여되고, 국무위원장에 대한 견제장치가 사라진 점도 근거로 들었다. 이종석 국정원장은 “북한이 핵을 포기하지 않겠다는 대외적 명확한 선언으로 핵무력 지휘권을 명기했다고 본다”고 말했다고 이 의원은 전했다. 앞서 북한은 지난 3월 최고인민회의 15기 제1차 회의에서 영토 조항을 신설하고 통일 관련 조항은 삭제한 개헌을 단행했다.)

Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Constitutional Amendment Fails by 12 Votes… Presidential Office Says “People Power Party Must Vote Responsibly Tomorrow” (12표 부족한 개헌안 통과…청 “국힘, 내일 책임감 갖고 투표해야”)
item.description:
Regarding the constitutional amendment failing to pass due to a lack of quorum on the 7th, the Presidential Office stated, “With another plenary session convened tomorrow, members of the People Power Party should participate in the vote with a sense of responsibility as constitutional institutions.” <<> Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jeong said in a briefing at the Presidential Office, “The constitutional amendment is a promise to the people… We express regret that the vote failed to be established due to a boycott. We will consider what measures can be taken within the legal and institutional framework to fulfill the purpose of the amendment.” <<> That afternoon, a constitutional amendment bill proposed by six parties including the Democratic Party of Korea, excluding the People Power Party, was presented to the plenary session, but the People Power Party, which had adopted an opposing party line, did not participate in the vote. To pass the amendment in the plenary session, approval from two-thirds (191 members) of the total registered lawmakers is required, which necessitates at least 12 votes in favor from People Power Party members. The amendment includes provisions to enshrine in the preamble of the Constitution the democratic ideals of the May 18 Democratization Movement and the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising, as well as to strengthen requirements for declaring martial law. <<> President Lee had urged the passage of the constitutional amendment at a cabinet meeting the previous day, saying, “Who among the people would oppose preventing illegal martial law any longer? Shouldn’t those who oppose be seen as advocates of illegal martial law?” <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (청와대가 7일 헌법 개정안이 의결 정족수 부족으로 ‘투표 불성립’된 것과 관련해 “내일 본회의가 한 번 더 소집되는 만큼 국민의힘 의원들이 헌법 기관으로 책임감을 갖고 투표에 참여해야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: North Korea's UN Ambassador Emphasizes Nuclear Status: "Not Bound by the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty" (북한 유엔 대사, 핵 보유 강조…“핵무기전파방지조약에 구속 안돼”)
item.description:
At the 11th Review Conference of the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) currently underway at the UN headquarters in New York, North Korea has asserted, "The Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) is not bound by the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty under any circumstances." (북한이 미국 뉴욕 유엔본부에서 진행중인 제11차 핵확산금지조약(NPT) 평가회의에서 “조선민주주의인민공화국(북한)은 그 어떤 경우에도 핵무기전파방지조약에 구속되지 않는다”고 주장했다.)

In a statement released through the Korean Central News Agency on the 7th, North Korea's UN Ambassador Kim Song said, "The United States and some countries following it are groundlessly interfering with the current status and sovereign rights of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state outside the treaty." Ambassador Kim justified the development of nuclear weapons, stating, "The Democratic People's Republic of Korea is faithfully fulfilling its obligations under the national nuclear force policy law, which most transparently declares the mission of nuclear forces, principles of nuclear use, and non-proliferation obligations, as well as the national constitution that solidifies its legal status as a nuclear weapons state." Kim emphasized North Korea's status as a nuclear weapons state based on the nuclear force policy enacted into law in September 2002 and the recently revised constitution. (김성 주유엔 북한대사는 7일 조선중앙통신을 통해 낸 담화에서 “미국과 그에 추종하는 일부 나라들이 조약 밖의 핵 보유국인 조선민주주의인민공화국의 현 지위와 주권적 권리행사를 무근거하게 걸고든다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 김 대사는 “조선민주주의인민공화국은 핵무력의 사명과 핵사용 원칙, 전파방지 의무를 가장 투명성 있게 천명한 국가핵무력정책법령과 핵 보유국으로서의 법적 지위를 고착시킨 국가 헌법에 따른 의무 이행해 충실한 것”이라며 핵무기 개발을 정당화했다. 김 대사는 2002년 9월 법령화한 핵무력정책과 최근 개정한 헌법에 근거해 핵 보유국 지위를 강조했다.)

Ambassador Kim further claimed, "We strongly denounce and reject the highly brigandish and shameless behavior of specific countries, led by the United States, who interfere with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea's legitimate and realistic nuclear possession through legal channels and its inherent right to self-defense as a sovereign state." (김 대사는 또 “합법적 경로를 거친 조선민주주의인민공화국의 현실 당위적인 핵 보유와 주권 국가로서의 고유한 방위적 권리행사를 걸고드는 미국을 위시한 특정국가들의 날강도적이며 파렴치한 행태를 가장 강력한 어조로 규탄배격한다”고 주장했다.)

North Korea withdrew from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty in 1993, with its position being that it exercised the right to withdraw from the treaty as stipulated in Article 10. (북한은 1993년 핵확산금지조약을 탈퇴했는데, 이는 조약 제10조에 명시된 조약탈퇴 권리를 행사했다는 게 북한의 입장이다.)

In this regard, Ambassador Kim argued, "Before the United States insists on the Democratic People's Republic of Korea's compliance with treaty obligations—having legally withdrawn from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty decades ago—it should first answer whether the same standards apply to its own implementation of obligations under various international treaties and international organization agreements from which it has withdrawn." (이에 김 대사는 “미국은 수십년 전에 핵무기전파방지조약에서 합법적으로 탈퇴한 조선민주주의인민공화국의 조약상 의무 준수 문제를 강변하기에 앞서 자기가 탈퇴한 각종 국제조약과 국제기구협약에 따른 의무 이행에도 꼭 같은 기준이 적용되는가에 대해서부터 답해야 할 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Ambassador Kim also made remarks seemingly targeting South Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines in cooperation with the United States. He said, "The key to implementing the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty is to correct the treaty violations of the United States and some countries, which are neglecting nuclear disarmament obligations while engaging in acts of proliferation, such as providing 'extended deterrence' to non-nuclear states and transferring nuclear submarine technology." (김 대사는 한국이 미국과 추진 중인 핵추진잠수함 개발을 겨냥한 듯한 발언도 이어갔다. 그는 “핵군축 의무를 태공(태업)하고 비핵국가들에 대한 '확장억제력' 제공과 핵잠수함 기술 이전과 같은 전파 행위들을 일삼고 있는 미국과 일부 나라들의 조약 의무 위반 행위를 바로잡는 일이야말로 핵무기전파방지조약 이행의 중심”이라고 말했다.)

In response, our government reiterated its established position that North Korea cannot be a nuclear weapons state. (이에 대해 우리 정부는 북한은 핵 보유국이 될 수 없다는 기존 입장을 강조했다.)

Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Park Il said at a regular briefing that day, "It is the consistent position of the international community that North Korea cannot have the status of a nuclear weapons state under the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT). This position has also been confirmed through UN Security Council resolutions." Park added, "While maintaining the goal of complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula, the government will continue to make efforts to achieve substantial progress in resolving the North Korean nuclear issue through a phased and practical approach in close cooperation with the international community." (외교부 박일 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “북한은 핵비확산조약(NPT)에 따라 핵 보유국 지위를 가질 수 없다는 것이 국제사회의 일관된 입장이다. 유엔 안보리 결의를 통해서도 이러한 입장이 확인된 바 있다”고 말했다. 박 대변인은 이어 “정부는 한반도의 완전한 비핵화 목표를 견지하는 가운데, 국제사회와의 긴밀한 공조하에 단계적이고 실용적인 접근을 통해서 북핵 문제 해결에 실질적 진전을 이루기 위한 노력을 계속 경주해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

At the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty Review Conference, which has been ongoing for four weeks since the 27th of last month, our government, together with France, held a session on the theme of "North Korea's Nuclear Challenge: Upholding the Integrity of the NPT." (지난달 27일부터 4주간 진행되고 있는 핵확산금지조약 평가 회의에서 우리 정부는 프랑스와 함께 ‘북핵 도전, 핵확산금지조약(NPT)의 온전성 수호’를 주제로 회의를 열기도 했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Aims to Win 13 of 14 By-elections and All Regional Elections (민주당 “재보궐은 14곳 중 13곳, 광역단체장은 전 지역 승리 목표”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has set a goal to sweep all 16 mayoral and gubernatorial elections and retain all 13 of its existing districts in the 14 National Assembly by-elections, excluding Daegu Dalseong, in the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거에서 16개 광역단체장 선거 전 지역 석권과 14곳의 국회의원 재보궐선거 가운데 대구 달성을 뺀 기존 민주당 지역구(13곳) 전체를 수성한다는 목표를 내세웠다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun said to reporters at the National Assembly on the 7th, "Among the 14 National Assembly by-election districts, 13 were Democratic Party districts. Shouldn't we defend those 13?" and added, "For the regional heads, we are aiming for victory in all areas." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 7일 국회에서 기자들을 만나 “국회의원 재보궐선거 지역 14개 중 13개가 민주당 지역구였다. 13개는 지켜야 하는 게 아닌가”라며 “광역단체장도 일단 모든 지역에서의 승리를 목표로 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding discussions on progressive unity, such as in the Ulsan mayoral election and the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election, Kang stated, "We will leave it to local judgment," indicating that discussions should be held at the city and provincial party level, not the central party. (강 수석대변인은 또 울산시장 선거와 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 등 진보 진영 단일화 가능성이 언급되는 것과 관련 “지역 판단에 맡기겠다”고 말했다. 중앙당 차원이 아닌, 시·도당 차원에서의 논의가 원칙이라고 밝힌 것이다.)

In the Ulsan mayoral election, where candidate Kim Sang-wook is running, there are talks of an electoral alliance with Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon, and it has been decided that this will be pursued under the leadership of the city and provincial party chairperson. Kang explained, "The issue of electoral alliances is not limited to Ulsan; it may also arise in mayoral, gubernatorial, and basic/metropolitan council races. The party leader and secretary-general announced at a joint meeting of city and provincial parties the day before that they hope this will be thoroughly judged under the chairperson's supervision." (김상욱 후보가 뛰고 있는 울산시장 선거는 진보당 김종훈 후보와의 선거연대 가능성이 제기되고 있는데 이를 시·도당위원장 주관으로 추진키로 했다는 설명이다. 강 수석대변인은 “선거연대 문제는 울산에만 한정된 것이 아니라 광역단체장, 기초·광역의원 등에도 있을 수 있다”며 “이를 철저히 시도당위원장 주관하에 (선거연대 여부나 방식을) 판단했으면 좋겠다는 뜻을 전날 시·도당 연석회의에서 당 대표와 사무총장이 발표했다”고 했다.)

Considering recent polls showing narrowing support gaps with People Power Party candidates in key battlegrounds, the Democratic Party plans to unveil region-specific policy pledges next week. The central party will draft the policy pledges, and they are expected to be announced jointly with local candidates. When asked if the recently proposed special counsel investigation law on manipulated prosecutions had influenced the sentiment in the Yeongnam region, Kang responded, "Since the People Power Party has nothing else for negative campaigning, they are forgetting the essence and engaging in political strife. We plan to respond actively." (민주당은 최근 여론조사에서 격전지를 중심으로 국민의힘 후보와 지지율 격차가 줄어드는 상황을 고려해 다음 주 중 지역 맞춤형 정책 공약을 내놓을 계획이라고 밝혔다. 중앙당이 총괄해 정책 공약을 마련하되, 지역별 후보들과 함께 발표하는 형식이 될 것으로 보인다. 강 수석대변인은 최근 발의한 조작기소 특검법이 영남권 판세에 영향을 줬다고 보느냐는 질문에는 “국민의힘이 네거티브 소재가 그것 밖에 없다보니 본질을 망각한 채 정쟁화를 일삼고 있다”며 “당에서 적극 대응할 생각”이라고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party's central election committee, which will oversee the local and by-elections, is scheduled to launch on the 10th. Party leader Lee Jae-myung will serve as the senior committee chairperson, and the party is considering appointing an external figure as a co-senior committee chairperson. (지방선거·재보궐 선거 전반을 총괄할 민주당 중앙당 선거대책위원회는 오는 10일 출범 예정이다. 정 대표가 상임선대위원장을 맡는 가운데 외부 인사를 영입해 공동 상임선대위원장을 두는 방안도 검토하고 있다.)

Meanwhile, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae said at a nomination convention for Incheon, Gyeonggi, and Jeju held at KINTEX in Goyang, Gyeonggi, "Set high goals, maintain a low posture, and always seek victory at the level of the people's expectations." He added, "Through 'Yoon Seok-yeol's nominations,' the People Power Party, which has yet to repent for the insurrection, will face the people's stern judgment." (한편 정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 경기 고양시 킨텍스에서 열린 인천·경기·제주 공천자대회에서 “목표는 높게, 자세는 낮게 (하고) 항상 국민 눈높이에서 승리를 일궈내길 바란다”며 “‘윤석열 공천’을 통해 아직 내란에 대해 반성하지 않는 국민의힘에 국민의 준엄한 심판이 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Regarding Jeong Hyeong-geun, Han Dong-hoon’s Campaign Committee Chair: “The Symbol of ‘Torture Investigations’…” (‘한동훈 후원회장’ 정형근에 “‘고문 수사’ 의혹 상징을…”)
item.description:
Criticism is mounting in political circles over independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in the June 3 by-election for Busan's Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat, appointing Jeong Hyeong-geun—a former prosecutor from the 1980s public security era and ex-lawmaker of the Grand National Party (predecessor of the People Power Party)—as his campaign committee chair. Critics say this “appointment of the symbol of ‘torture investigation’ allegations as campaign committee chair” constitutes a “grave insult to citizens who risked their lives to protect democracy.” (한동훈 6·3 국회의원 부산 북갑 보궐선거 무소속 후보가 1980년대 공안검사 출신인 정형근 전 한나라당(국민의힘 전신) 의원을 후원회장으로 위촉한 것을 두고 정치권에서 비판이 커지고 있다. “‘고문 수사’ 의혹의 상징을 후원회장으로 위촉”해 “목숨 걸고 민주주의를 지켜온 시민들에 대한 심각한 모욕”을 저질렀다는 것이다.)

Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, stated in a written briefing on the 7th, “Candidate Han has appointed Jeong Hyeong-geun, a notorious ‘hatchet man’ of the past dictatorial regime and the symbol of ‘torture investigation’ allegations, as his campaign committee chair,” adding, “This is a serious insult to citizens who risked their lives to defend democracy, and a shocking event that brings the specter of dictatorship to the forefront of an election meant to dismantle insurrection.” ( 손솔 진보당 수석대변인은 7일 서면브리핑에서 “한 후보가 과거 독재 정권의 서슬 퍼런 ‘칼잡이’이자 ‘고문 수사’ 의혹의 상징인 정형근을 후원회장으로 위촉했다”며 “목숨 걸고 민주주의를 지켜온 시민들에 대한 심각한 모욕이며, 내란청산 선거 전면에 독재의 망령을 내세운 경악스러운 사건”이라고 비판했다. )

Spokesperson Son further questioned Han, asking, “Is this a calculation to beg for votes with the ghost of dictatorship, or a declaration of a return to the era of dictatorship altogether?” and continued, “Remember clearly that Han Dong-hoon’s choice is a wretched regression and a frontal challenge to the Constitution, history, and people of the Republic of Korea.” ( 손 대변인은 한 후보를 향해 “독재의 망령으로 표를 구걸하겠다는 계산인가, 아니면 아예 독재 시절로 회귀하겠다는 선언인가”라며 “한동훈 후보의 선택은 처참한 퇴행이며, 대한민국 헌법과 역사, 그리고 국민에 대한 정면 도전이라는 사실을 똑똑히 기억하라”고 했다. )

Park Won-seok, a former lawmaker of the Justice Party, also appeared on JTBC's YouTube channel ‘Genre Yeouido’ on the same day, asserting, “Who is Jeong Hyeong-geun? He is the epitome of public security governance and bears responsibility for the torture of numerous democratic figures, including former lawmaker Kim Geun-tae.” Park added, “Jeong has never properly apologized or acknowledged responsibility. For people like us, just hearing his name infuriates us.” (박원석 전 정의당 의원도 이날 제이티비시(JTBC) 유튜브 ‘장르만 여의도’에 나와 “정형근이 누구인가. 공안 통치의 대명사이면서 김근태 전 의원을 비롯한 수많은 민주 인사들 고문에 책임이 있는 사람”이라고 주장했다. 박 전 의원은 “(정 전 의원은) 한번도 제대로 사과하거나 책임을 인정한 적이 없는 사람”이라며 “저희 같은 사람은 그냥 이름만 들어도 빡치는(화가 나는) 사람”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Park Sang-hyuk, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, also criticized on the same day, saying, “This is that very Jeong Hyeong-geun, who made a name for himself as a public security prosecutor during the dictatorship era. Han Dong-hoon, who was a key figure in the prosecution coup as Yoon Seok-yeol’s underling, has appointed exactly such a person as his campaign committee chair. Once again, we are left in shock by their behavior.” ( 박상혁 더불어민주당 의원도 이날 “ 독재 정권 시절 공안검사로 이름을 날렸던 그 정형근이다. 윤석열의 하수인으로 검찰 쿠데타의 주역이었던 한동훈 씨가 후원회장으로 모실 만한 바로 그런 사람 ” 이라며 “ 다시 한번 이들의 행태에 경악할 수 밖에 없다 ”고 비판했다. )

Former lawmaker Jeong served as a prosecutor in 1983 when he was dispatched to the Agency for National Security Planning (ANSP), working primarily in public security and counterintelligence. During the investigation of the ‘Seo Gyeong-won’s visit to North Korea’ case, he faced allegations of torture, among other cases, leading to multiple lawsuits on torture charges. ( 정 전 의원은 검사 시절인 1983년 안기부에 파견돼 공안·방첩 분야에서 주로 일했다. ‘서경원 의원 방북 사건’ 등을 수사할 당시 고문 의혹이 제기되는 등 여러 건의 고문 혐의로 피소됐다. )

Previously, in 1999, the prosecution announced that they had secured statements from ANSP officials claiming that Jeong, then head of the ANSP’s Public Security Investigation Bureau in 1989, personally tortured Seo Gyeong-won, then a lawmaker of the Peace Democratic Party. According to the statements, “Director Jeong came directly to the interrogation room, sent out the investigators, locked the door, and investigated Seo alone,” with reports of Jeong shouting loudly. When investigators entered after the session, “Seo’s face was covered in blood.” At the time, Jeong denied the torture allegations, saying, “Given the gravity of the case, thorough investigation was conducted, but there was no abusive behavior like torture.” The statute of limitations for that case had already expired in 1999. ( 앞서 1999년 검찰은 정 전 의원이 1989년 안기부 대공수사국장으로 있으면서 서경원 당시 평화민주당 의원을 직접 고문했다는 안기부 관계자들의 진술을 확보했다고 밝힌 바 있다. “정형근 당시 국장이 직접 조사실로 와 수사관들을 내보낸 뒤 문을 잠근 채 혼자 서 의원을 조사했다”며 “정 국장이 고성을 지르는 소리가 새나왔고, 조사를 마친 뒤 들어가보니 서 전 의원 얼굴이 피투성이가 돼 있었다”고 진술했다는 것이다. 당시 정 전 의원은 “사안의 중대성을 감안해 철저한 수사를 했을 뿐 고문 등 가혹행위는 없었다”며 고문 의혹을 부인한 바 있다. 해당 사건의 공소시효는 1999년 이미 끝난 상태였다. )

Former lawmaker Jeong was also suspected of involvement in the torture of Kim Geun-tae, known as the ‘godfather of the democratization movement.’ In 1999, the prosecution released the ‘Results of the Investigation into the Torture Case by Former Inspector Lee Geun-an,’ stating that in 1985, the police deployed ‘torture specialist’ Lee Geun-an to investigate Kim on the orders of Jeong, then head of the ANSP’s Public Security Investigation Unit, to “thoroughly uncover the truth even through coercion.” Jeong strongly denied this as well, claiming, “The prosecution is fabricating me as the mastermind behind the torture.” This suspicion also fell under the statute of limitations, making criminal punishment impossible. (정 전 의원은 ‘민주화 운동의 대부’ 김근태 전 의원 고문에 관여했다는 의혹을 받기도 했다. 검찰은 1999년 ‘이근안 전 경감 고문사건 진상조사 결과’를 발표하며 1985년 경찰이 김 전 의원 수사에 ‘고문 기술자’ 이근안을 투입한 것은 “혼을 내서라도 철저히 밝혀내라”는 당시 안기부 대공수사단장이었던 정 전 의원의 지시에 따른 것이라고 밝힌 바 있다. 해당 의혹에 대해서도 정 전 의원은 “검찰이 나를 고문 배후로 날조하고 있다”며 강하게 부인했다. 해당 의혹 역시 공소시효가 끝나 형사처벌이 불가능했다.)

After serving as the first deputy director of the ANSP, Jeong was elected in the 1996 15th general election as a candidate for the ruling New Korea Party in Busan's Buk-gu·Gangseo-gu District, serving three consecutive terms. He lost the nomination in the 2008 18th general election when he was pushed out by Park Min-sik, who is now competing against Han in the Busan Buk-gu Gap race. Since then, he has served as the standing chairman of the New Right National Alliance, among other roles. ( 정 전 의원은 안기부에서 제1차장까지 지낸 뒤 1996년 15대 총선에서 여당인 신한국당 후보로 부산 북구·강서갑에서 당선된 뒤 내리 3선을 지냈다. 2008년 18대 총선 때 이번 부산 북갑 선거에서 한 후보와 경쟁하는 박민식 후보에 밀려 공천에서 탈락했다. 이후 뉴라이트전국연합 상임의장 등으로 활동했다. )

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr ( 전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party’s Yoo Ui-dong on Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul: “I’m a Local… Do Other Candidates Even Know Pyeongtaek?” (‘경기 평택을’ 국힘 유의동 “난 토박이…다른 후보들, 평택을 아나?”)
item.description:
“Every candidate except me has only had Pyeongtaek on their mind for at most three months and at least ten days. These are people who chose Pyeongtaek for their own political careers.” (“저를 제외한 모든 후보가 평택을 마음속에 둔 게 길게는 3개월이고 짧게는 열흘 정도입니다. 자기 정치를 위해 평택을 선택한 사람들이잖아요.”)

Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate in the by-election for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, which coincides with the June 3 local elections, emphasized throughout an interview on the 7th at his election office in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, that he is a native of the area. He has served three consecutive terms (19th to 21st National Assembly) representing Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul. “The Democratic Party already has enough seats for President Lee Jae-myung,” Yoo said. “I will bring back a seat for the citizens of Pyeongtaek.” With the by-election in Pyeongtaek-eul triggered by the loss of seat of former Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Byung-jin due to a violation of the Public Official Election Act, five candidates are competing: Yoo Ui-dong, Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 유의동 국민의힘 후보는 7일 평택시 안중읍 선거사무소에서 한 인터뷰 내내 자신이 평택 토박이임을 강조했다. 그는 경기 평택을에서만 3선(19~21대) 의원을 지냈다. 유 후보는 “이재명 대통령을 위한 민주당 의석은 이미 충분하다”며 “평택 시민을 위한 의석을 찾아오겠다”고 말했다. 더불어민주당 출신 이병진 의원이 공직선거법 위반으로 의원직을 상실하면서 재선거가 열리는 평택을에서는 유 후보를 포함해 김용남 더불어민주당 후보, 조국 조국혁신당 후보, 김재연 진보당 후보, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보 등 5명이 경쟁을 벌이고 있다.)

―Why should it be Yoo Ui-dong? (―왜 유의동이어야 하나?)

“My campaign slogan is ‘A Lifetime in Pyeongtaek.’ For me, Pyeongtaek isn’t just somewhere I visit during elections. This place is the reason for my politics, and it’s the reason I’m needed here now.” (“선거 구호가 ‘평생을 평택에서’다. 내게 평택은 선거 때만 찾아오는 곳이 아니다. 이곳이 내 정치의 이유이고, 지금 이곳에 내가 필요한 이유다.”)

―What’s the most pressing issue? (―가장 시급한 현안은?)

“The population increases by 1,000 to 2,000 people every month, but living infrastructure can’t keep up with the city’s growth rate. I’m preparing pledges to fill the gaps in transportation, healthcare, education, and childcare. Beyond that, I’ll expand transportation networks, such as establishing a new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Line and extending the Shinbundang Line to Seojeong-ri Station.” (“매달 인구가 1천~2천명 늘어나는데 생활 인프라가 도시 성장 속도를 못 따라간다. 교통·의료·교육·보육에서 부족한 부분을 채울 공약을 준비하고 있다. 이 밖에도 고속전철(KTX) 경기남부선 신설, 서정리역 신분당선 연장 등 교통망을 확충할 거다.”)

―It’s a five-way race. (―5자 구도 선거인데.)

“I’m cautious about predictions, but I think there will be some attempt at a progressive camp unification in one form or another.” (“예측은 조심스럽지만, 어떤 형태로든 진보 진영 단일화 시도는 있을 것이라고 생각한다.”)

―How do you evaluate Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Innovation Party candidate Cho Kuk? (―김용남 민주당 후보, 조국 혁신당 후보를 어떻게 평가하나?)

“One wanted to go to Hanam, and the other wanted to go to Busan. All their pledges are problematic—they’re just repeating what someone else said. Candidate Kim Yong-nam made building a Pyeongtaek Western Police Station his number one pledge. But the budget for constructing a Pyeongtaek Northern Police Station is already confirmed, so he’s now proposing a third police station. Then Candidate Cho Kuk attacked him, asking, ‘Why build it in the west instead of the north?’ This is something the state will handle as the population grows—it’s not something a lawmaker can decide. They’re like seven-year-olds arguing within their own limited knowledge. They talk about knowing Pyeongtaek, but it’s childish.” (“한분은 하남 가고 싶어 했고 한분은 부산 가고 싶어 했다. 그들의 모든 공약이 문제가 있다. 누군가가 하던 이야기를 자기 입으로 옮긴 것뿐이다. 김용남 후보는 평택서부경찰서 짓는 걸 1호 공약으로 냈더라. 평택북부경찰서가 지어지는 건 이미 예산까지 확정돼 있으니 김 후보는 지금 세번째 경찰서를 짓겠다는 거다. 그걸 갖고 조국 후보는 ‘왜 북부가 아니고 서부에 짓냐’고 공격하더라. 이건 인구가 늘어나면 국가가 알아서 할 일이지 국회의원이 할 수 있는 게 아니다. 일곱살짜리 아이들이 자신이 아는 범위 안에서 싸우는 것 같다. 서로 ‘평택을 안다’고 얘기하는데 유치하다.”)

―Freedom and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn has suggested he might unify with you. (―황교안 자유와혁신 후보는 유 후보와 단일화 생각이 있다는데.)

“I’m not very interested. I understand many in the conservative base think unification is necessary, but it’s not a priority for me right now.” (“별 관심 없다. 보수 지지층에서 단일화가 필요하다는 분들이 많은 건 이해한다. 현재로선 제게 우선순위가 아니다.”)

―Will you campaign together if party leader Jang Dong-hyuk comes? (―장동혁 대표가 오면 같이 유세할 건가?)

“That’s not the essence of this election. As seen in the case of the special counsel for the withdrawal of the indictment, the Lee Jae-myung administration already has enough seats to do whatever it wants. This election is about bringing back a seat for the citizens of Pyeongtaek.” (“이게 선거의 본질이 아니다. 공소취소 특검에서 보듯 이재명 정부는 하고 싶은 것을 할 수 있을 만큼 충분한 의석을 갖고 있다. 평택 시민을 위한 의석을 찾아오는 선거가 이번 선거다.”)

―Will you ask former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min for campaign support? (―유승민 전 의원에게 지원 유세를 요청할 건가?)

“He certainly has a strong appeal to the centrist voters. He can play a symbolic role in expanding the conservative base.” (“중도층에 대한 소구력이 확실히 있는 분이다. 보수 외연 확장에 상징적 역할을 할 수 있는 분이다.”)

By Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Iran's State TV Claims “Korean Ship Was a Target”… Iranian Embassy in Seoul Draws a Line (이란 국영방송 “한국 선박 표적”…주한 이란대사관은 일단 ‘선긋기’)
item.description:
The Iranian Embassy in Seoul has dismissed a report by Iran's state-run television that a Korean vessel damaged by fire near the Strait of Hormuz was targeted because it violated relevant regulations, calling it “merely a commentary.” The embassy maintains that the fire on the HMM NAMU is unrelated to Iranian forces, but conflicting reports from state media have created a discrepancy in positions. (이란 국영 방송이 호르무즈해협 인근에서 화재 피해를 당한 한국 선박이 관련 규정을 어겨 표적이 됐다고 보도한 데 대해 주한이란대사관이 “논평에 불과하다”고 선을 그었다. 이란 대사관은 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 화재가 이란군과 관련이 없다는 입장이지만, 관영매체에선 다른 보도가 나와 입장이 엇갈리는 상황이다.)

On the 7th, the Iranian Embassy stated, “The report by Iran's Press TV is a commentary prepared by an external analysis desk and does not represent an official position of the Iranian government or the embassy, nor confirmed operational details.” The embassy added, “To date, we have not received any official or verified information confirming Iranian involvement in incidents related to the Korean vessel.” (이란 대사관은 7일 “이란 프레스티브이(TV) 보도는 외부 분석 데스크에 의해 작성된 논평으로, 이란 정부나 이란 대사관이 발표한 공식 입장이나 확인된 작전 사항을 의미하지 않는다”고 입장을 냈다. 대사관은 “현재까지 한국 선박과 관련된 사건에 대해 이란의 개입을 확인할 수 있는 공식적이거나 검증된 정보를 전달받지 못했다”고도 했다.)

Earlier, on the 6th (local time), Iran's English-language state media Press TV reported, “The targeting of a Korean vessel (referring to the NAMU) that violated Iran's new maritime regulations sends a clear message,” suggesting that Iran had attacked the ship. This contradicts the same-day statement from the Iranian Embassy, which “strongly rejects and clearly denies any allegations of the Iranian military's involvement in the incident of damage to a Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz.” In response, the Iranian Embassy stated, “Any interpretations or analyses reported by the media should not be considered official positions. The embassy's official stance remains unchanged. Given the current sensitive regional situation, speculative reports or unverified claims should be handled with caution until the official investigation results are released.” (앞서 이란의 영어권 관영매체 프레스티브이는 6일(현지시각) “이란의 새로운 해상 규정을 위반한 한국 선박(나무호 지칭)을 표적으로 삼은 행위는 명확한 메시지를 전달한다”며 이란이 해당 선박을 공격했음을 시사하는 보도를 했다. 같은날 이란 대사관이 “호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란 군대가 개입했다는 어떤 의혹도 강력히 거부하며, 명확히 부인한다”는 성명을 낸 것과는 배치되는 내용이다. 이에 이란 대사관은 “언론이 보도하는 어떤 해석이나 분석도 공식 입장으로 간주돼선 안 된다”며 “대사관의 공식 입장은 변함없다. 현재의 민감한 지역 정세 속에서 공식 조사 결과가 발표될 때까지 추측성 보도나 검증되지 않은 주장은 신중하게 다뤄져야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

The NAMU, anchored in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, suffered a fire due to an explosion and is scheduled to be towed to Dubai port on the evening of the 7th (local time). The government maintains that without prejudging possibilities such as an attack, a thorough investigation into the exact cause is the priority. (지난 4일 호르무즈해협에 정박해 있던 나무호는 폭발로 인한 화재가 발생해 현지시각 7일 밤 두바이 항구로 예인될 예정이다. 정부는 피격 가능성 등을 예단하지 않고 정확한 원인 조사가 우선이라는 입장이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] Jeong Seung-yoon and Yoon Seok-yeol meet late at night before ACRC closes 'Kim Keon-hee luxury bag case' ([단독] 정승윤-윤석열 심야회동 뒤 권익위 ‘김건희 명품백 사건’ 종결)
item.description:
It has been revealed that Jeong Seung-yoon, former Deputy Chairperson and Secretary-General of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC), who led the closure of the 'Kim Keon-hee Luxury Bag Receiving Case' in 2024, met with former President Yoon Seok-yeol during the process of handling the case. Evidence has also emerged that the former Secretary-General engaged in 'workplace harassment' against the ACRC official in charge of the case, who took their own life after the case was closed. <<> According to the investigation results of the 'ACRC Normalization Promotion Task Force (TF)' on past cases released on the 7th, the TF stated in its investigation findings that "the former Secretary-General delayed the handling of the case against the opinion of the responsible department, and during the case processing, held an unofficial meeting (for 1 hour) late at night at the presidential residence with the side of the reported person (former President Yoon, etc.)." <<> The TF also confirmed circumstances suggesting that the former Secretary-General had pre-determined the decision to close the case before the ACRC's plenary committee meeting. The TF noted that the former Secretary-General "convened an unofficial meeting two hours before the meeting to mention the direction of handling (closure) and personally drafted the resolution," and decided to request an investigation into the case by the National Investigation Headquarters, which is currently investigating it. <<> The TF further confirmed circumstances showing that the former Secretary-General harassed at work Kim, the former ACRC Bureau Director for Corruption Prevention, who was found dead in August 2024 after the case was closed. Before his death, former Director Kim had expressed extreme self-loathing over the case being closed as 'no legal violations,' as reported by The Hankyoreh. <<> The TF determined that "the former Secretary-General unjustly treated the deceased, who held opposing views on closing the luxury bag case, by restricting their right to speak during meetings and excluding them from key case-related tasks, and publicly criticized them," adding that "there is a high likelihood that this constitutes workplace harassment." <<> The former Deputy Chairperson has currently declared his candidacy for the Busan Metropolitan City Superintendent of Education election. <<> Kim Chae-woon, reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (2024년 ‘김건희 명품 가방 수수 사건’ 종결 처리를 주도한 정승윤 전 국민권익위원회(권익위) 부위원장 겸 사무처장이 사건 처리 과정에서 윤석열 전 대통령을 만난 것으로 밝혀졌다. 정 전 사무처장이 이 사건이 종결 처리된 뒤 스스로 목숨을 끊은 권익위 실무 책임자에게 ‘직장 내 괴롭힘’을 한 정황도 드러났다.)

item.title: First Korea-Japan Vice-Ministerial Diplomatic and Defense Meeting… Cooperation on ‘Reopening the Strait of Hormuz’ Also Explored (한일 첫 차관급 외교·국방 회의…‘호르무즈 재개방’ 협력도 모색)
item.description:
South Korea and Japan held their first vice-ministerial diplomatic and defense meeting (2+2) in Seoul on the 7th to discuss security cooperation. (한국과 일본이 7일 서울에서 첫 차관급 외교·국방회의(2+2) 회의를 열고 안보 협력을 논의했다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that First Vice Minister Park Yoon-ju, Vice Minister of National Defense Lee Doo-hee, Japanese Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs Takehiro Funakoshi, and Defense Counselor Koji Kano held the 14th Korea-Japan Security Policy Consultation at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs that day. Both sides assessed that shuttle diplomacy between Korea and Japan is being actively conducted through recent trust and bonds between the leaders, and agreed to continue the flow of exchanges and cooperation at all levels between diplomatic and defense authorities based on this momentum. (외교부는 박윤주 1차관과 이두희 국방부 차관, 일본의 후나코시 다케히로 외무사무차관과 가노 고지 방위심의관이 이날 외교부에서 제14차 한일 안보정책협의회를 개최했다고 밝혔다. 양측은 최근 한·일 정상 간 신뢰와 유대를 통해 한·일 셔틀외교가 활발하게 이루어지고 있음을 평가하고 이러한 모멘텀을 바탕으로 외교·국방 당국 간에도 각급에서 교류와 협력의 흐름을 이어나가기로 했다.)

Additionally, the vice ministers exchanged views on the global security environment, including the recent situation in the Middle East, and the situation on the Korean Peninsula. As both Korea and Japan import large amounts of energy from the Middle East, they appear to have explored cooperation measures for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and strengthening energy security. (아울러, 양국 차관들은 최근 중동 상황을 비롯한 글로벌 안보 환경과 한반도 정세 등에 관해서도 의견을 교환했다. 한·일 모두 중동에서 다량의 에너지를 수입하는 만큼 호르무즈해협 재개방과 에너지 안보 강화를 위한 협력 방안을 모색한 것으로 보인다.)

Both sides confirmed a shared recognition that cooperation among Korea, Japan, and Korea-U.S.-Japan is becoming more important amid the increasingly severe international situation, and agreed to continuously communicate to advance this. Previously, President Lee Jae-myung and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi shared their recognition of the importance of Korea-Japan and Korea-U.S.-Japan security cooperation at a summit held in Nara Prefecture, Japan, last January. Korea and Japan are also coordinating a schedule for Prime Minister Takaichi to make a return visit to President Lee’s hometown of Andong. (양측은 국제정세가 나날이 엄중해지고 있는 현 상황에서 한·일, 한·미·일 간 협력이 더욱 중요해지고 있다는 공통된 인식을 확인하고, 이를 진전시켜 나가기 위해 지속적으로 소통해 나가기로 했다. 앞서 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리는 지난 1월 일본 나라현에서 열린 정상회담에서 한·일, 한·미·일 안보 협력 중요성에 대한 인식을 공유한 바 있다. 한·일 양국은 다카이치 총리가 이 대통령의 고향 안동을 답방하는 일정도 조율중이다.)

The Korea-Japan Security Policy Consultation has been held at least once a year since 1998, following the action plan of the Kim Dae-jung-Obuchi Declaration (Joint Declaration on a New Korea-Japan Partnership for the 21st Century). It has been operated at the director-general level until now, but was elevated to the vice-ministerial level for the first time this time. This reflects a consensus that Korea and Japan need to cooperate more closely in a situation where trust in U.S. alliances is weakening under the second Trump administration. (한·일 안보정책협의회는 1998년 김대중-오부치 선언(21세기 새로운 한일 파트너십 공동선언) 행동계획에 따라 매년 1회 이상 개최해 왔다. 그동안은 국장급에서 운영해오다가 이번에 처음으로 차관급으로 격상시켜 열렸다. 트럼프 2기 행정부에서 미국의 동맹에 대한 신뢰가 약화되는 상황에서 한·일이 더욱 긴밀히 협력해야 한다는 공감대가 반영된 것이다.)

However, there is a difference in temperature between Korea and Japan regarding the scope and level of cooperation. While the Japanese government is active in concluding a Reciprocal Access Agreement for material cooperation between the South Korean military and the Self-Defense Forces, our government is known to be taking a cautious stance. Japan takes an active stance toward U.S. initiatives to contain China, while Korea maintains that its relationship with China must be managed more amicably. (다만 협력 범위와 수준에 대해서는 한·일 간 온도차가 있다. 일본 정부는 한국군과 자위대 간 물자 협력을 위한 상호군수지원협정 체결에 적극적이지만, 우리 정부는 신중한 입장인 것으로 알려졌다. 일본은 중국을 억제하려는 미국의 구상에 적극적인 태도를 보이지만, 한국은 중국과의 관계를 더 원만하게 관리해야 한다는 입장이다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Sewol Ferry Victims’ Families’ Long-Cherished ‘Life Safety Basic Law’ Passes National Assembly Plenary Session (세월호 유족 숙원 ‘생명안전기본법’ 국회 본회의 통과했다)
item.description:
The 'Life Safety Basic Law', a long-cherished wish of the families of the Sewol ferry disaster victims, passed the National Assembly on the 7th. (세월호 참사 유족들의 숙원이었던 ‘생명안전기본법’이 7일 국회를 통과했다.)

On this day, the National Assembly held a plenary session and processed 115 livelihood-related bills, including the Life Safety Basic Law, through bipartisan agreement. The Life Safety Basic Law codifies the 'right to safety', the right of all citizens to be protected from the risks of safety accidents, and stipulates the state's duty to guarantee it. It also includes provisions to establish a National Life Safety Committee under the President and a National Safety Accident Investigation Committee under the Prime Minister, and to require the government to establish a comprehensive life safety plan every five years. At a meeting of senior secretaries held at the presidential office that day, President Lee Jae-myung stated, "This law embodies our collective reflection and resolve that the loss of citizens' lives due to the absence of the state must never happen again," and requested the preparation of follow-up institutional arrangements. <<> At the plenary session, a 'Special Act on the National Appropriation of Property of Pro-Japanese Anti-National Collaborators' was also passed, which re-establishes the 'Property Investigation Committee of Pro-Japanese Anti-National Collaborators'—whose activities ended in 2010—and expands the scope of confiscation to include not only pro-Japanese assets but also the proceeds from their disposal. Additionally, revisions of the law passed the plenary session, transforming the current Framework Act on Low Birth Rate and Aging Society into the 'Framework Act on Population Strategy' and expanding and reorganizing the Presidential Committee on Low Birth Rate and Aging Society into the 'Presidential Committee on Population Strategy' to address not only low birth rates and aging but also changes in population structure, such as regional population imbalances. <<> Other bills processed included an amendment to the Labor Standards Act, allowing annual paid leave to be taken in hourly increments and prohibiting employers from giving unfavorable treatment on the grounds of using annual leave, and an amendment to the Road Traffic Act, which criminalizes individuals who knowingly provide a vehicle to or encourage a drunken driver to drive. <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (국회는 이날 본회의를 열어 생명안전기본법 등 민생법안 115건을 여야 합의로 처리했다. 생명안전기본법은 모든 국민이 안전사고의 위험으로부터 보호받을 권리인 ‘안전권’을 명문화하고, 국가의 보장 책무를 명시했다. 대통령 소속의 국민생명안전위원회와 국무총리 소속 국가안전사고조사위원회를 설치하고, 정부가 5년마다 생명안전종합계획을 세우도록 하는 내용도 담겼다. 이재명 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관회의에서 “이 법안에는 다시는 국가의 부재 때문에 국민의 생명을 잃는 일이 있어서는 안 된다는 우리 모두의 반성과 다짐이 들어 있다”며 후속 제도 정비를 준비해달라고 주문했다.)

item.title: Seo Byung-soo Leaves People Power Party...To Serve as Honorary Co-Chair of Han Dong-hoon's Campaign (서병수, 국민의힘 탈당…한동훈 캠프 명예선대위원장 맡는다)
item.description:
<<>> Former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo left the People Power Party on the 7th and decided to support independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in Busan's Buk-gu Gap district. ()

In a phone call with The Hankyoreh on the same day, Seo said, "It's a party I haven't left for 30 years, but it didn't seem proper to help an independent candidate while still being a member, so I cleanly resigned and decided to serve as the honorary co-chair of Han Dong-hoon's campaign." Seo stated that he submitted his resignation around 5:30 PM that day. He plans to attend the opening ceremony of Han's campaign office on the 10th. ( 서병수 전 의원이 7일 국민의힘을 탈당하고, 부산 북갑에 출마한 한동훈 무소속 후보를 지원하기로 했다.)

Candidate Han posted on Facebook, saying, "I am appointing former Busan Mayor Seo Byung-soo as the honorary campaign co-chair for Han Dong-hoon in Busan's Buk-gu Gap district," and added, "I deeply thank and respect his courageous decision for the future of Buk-gu and the reconstruction of conservatism." item.title: Investigation into the M/T HMM Naju Imminent…Iran Reaffirms via Video Call “We Did Not Attack” (나무호 조사 임박…이란, 화상면담서 “우린 공격 안했다” 재확인)
item.description:
A joint government investigation team arrived at the Port of Dubai in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on the 7th (local time) and began a full-scale investigation into the South Korean cargo ship HMM Naju. The M/T HMM Naju had anchored in the Strait of Hormuz before experiencing an explosion and fire on the 4th. (정부 합동조사단이 7일(현지시각) 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이항에 도착해 한국 화물선 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에 대한 본격 조사에 들어갔다. 나무호는 호르무즈해협에 정박해 있다가 지난 4일 폭발·화재가 났다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il said at a briefing at the ministry building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, that day, “The M/T HMM Naju is expected to arrive at the (Dubai) port on the night of the 7th local time,” adding, “The investigation team departed South Korea for Dubai last night.” The team consists of three investigators from the Korean Maritime Safety Tribunal under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and four forensic experts from the National Fire Agency. (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 서울 종로구 외교부 청사에서 한 브리핑에서 “에이치엠엠 나무호가 현지시각으로 7일 밤 (두바이) 항구에 도착할 것으로 예상된다”며 “어젯밤 조사단이 한국에서 두바이로 출국했다”고 말했다. 조사단은 해양수산부 산하 중앙해양안전심판원 조사관 3명과 소방청 감식 전문가 4명으로 구성됐다.)

The towing operation for the M/T HMM Naju began on the morning of the 7th. A local tugboat, which departed Dubai around 8:30 p.m. on the 6th, arrived near the vessel around 3:30 a.m. on the 7th and began preparations for towing around 11 a.m. The M/T HMM Naju will undergo repairs and an investigation into the cause of the accident at Drydocks World Dubai, the largest repair shipyard in the Middle East, located at the Port of Dubai. (나무호 예인 작업은 7일 오전부터 시작됐다. 6일 저녁 8시30분께 두바이를 출발한 현지 예인선은 7일 새벽 3시30분께 나무호 근처에 도착해 오전 11시께부터 예인 준비 작업에 들어갔다. 에이치엠엠 나무호는 두바이항에 있는 중동 최대 수리 조선소인 드라이독 월드 두바이에서 수리와 함께 사고 원인 조사를 받는다.)

U.S. President Donald Trump has pointed to an Iranian attack as the cause of the accident, but the South Korean government maintains a cautious stance. A foreign ministry official stated, “What is needed at this point is to determine the cause.” (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 사고 원인으로 이란의 공격을 지목했지만, 한국 정부는 신중한 기조를 유지하고 있다. 외교부 당국자는 “현시점에서 필요한 것은 원인 규명”이라고 말했다.)

National Assembly Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee Chairman Kim Seok-ki reported that during a video call that day, Ebrahim Azizi, chairman of the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, said, “The Iranian military did not attack the M/T HMM Naju. If the Iranian government or military had actually targeted the South Korean vessel, we would have proudly admitted it.” (이날 김석기 국회 외교통일위원장과 화상 면담을 한 에브라힘 아지지 이란 의회 국가안보·외교정책 위원장은 “이란군이 나무호를 공격하지 않았다. 이란 정부나 군이 정말 한국 선박을 표적 삼아서 공격한 게 사실이라면 우리가 했다고 당당하게 이야기했을 것이다”라고 말했다고 김 위원장이 전했다.)

item.title: Han Deok-su sentenced to 15 years in appeals trial… Why the 8-year reduction? [Gongdeokpocha] (한덕수, 항소심서 징역 15년 선고…8년이나 깎인 이유는? [공덕포차])
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Han Deok-su, accused of participating in insurrection during the December 3 martial law emergency, was sentenced to 15 years in prison at the second trial held on the 7th. This is an 8-year reduction from the first trial’s 23-year sentence. The second trial court upheld most of the major charges as guilty, similar to the first trial, but acquitted Han on some charges, including perjury during the Constitutional Court’s impeachment trial, differing from the first trial’s ruling. (12·3 비상계엄 당시 내란에 가담한 혐의를 받는 한덕수 전 국무총리가 7일 열린 2심에서 징역 15년을 선고받았습니다. 1심의 징역 23년에서 8년이 깎인 건데요. 2심 재판부는 1심과 마찬가지로 주요 혐의 대부분을 유죄로 인정했지만, 헌법재판소 탄핵심판 위증 등 일부 혐의는 1심과 달리 무죄로 판단했습니다.)

Former Presidential Chief of Staff Jeong Jin-seok withdrew his application for nomination in the Chungnam Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election for the People Power Party on the same day. Amid controversy over the ‘Yoon-again nomination’ that sparked internal backlash, and after nomination committee chair Park Deok-heum, who is also his in-law, urged him to drop out, he abandoned his bid. (정진석 전 대통령 비서실장이 이날 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 공천 신청을 철회했는데요. ‘윤어게인 공천’ 논란으로 당내 반발이 확산하고 사돈인 박덕흠 공천관리위원장까지 나서 출마를 만류하자 뜻을 접었습니다.)

Why was former Prime Minister Han Deok-su’s sentence reduced by 8 years in the second trial? Is there a real reason behind former Chief Jeong Jin-seok, who was even expected to run as an independent, dropping out? When will the controversy over the withdrawal of charges in the ‘fabricated indictment special counsel’ subside? Let’s find out in . Check out the video! item.title: Constitutional amendment fails as People Power Party boycotts vote; revote scheduled for the 8th (개헌안, 국힘 불참에 ‘투표 불성립’…8일 재표결)
item.description:
The proposed amendment to the Constitution of the Republic of Korea was brought before the National Assembly plenary session on the 7th, but the People Power Party (PPP) refused to participate in the vote, resulting in the vote itself not being held due to a lack of quorum. National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik announced that he would reconvene the plenary session on the 8th for a revote on the amendment, but with the PPP sticking to its boycott, calling it a "hastily patched-up piecemeal amendment," a national referendum on the amendment alongside the June 3 local elections has effectively become difficult. <<> The National Assembly opened its plenary session at around 2:25 PM that day to table the amendment. Speaker Woo stated, "This is a historic starting point to open the door to constitutional revision, which has been stalled for 39 years since 1987," adding, "Having witnessed the gaps in the Constitution during the December 3 martial law crisis, the Assembly seeks to fulfill its historic responsibility by establishing constitutional safeguards to prevent such misfortune from recurring." However, PPP Deputy Chief Whip Yoo Sang-beom, after saying, "Pushing through a unilateral constitutional amendment is a strategic move ahead of the elections," left the chamber. <<> Speaker Woo repeatedly urged PPP lawmakers to participate, but they held a caucus meeting in the Budget and Accounts Special Committee room across from the plenary hall and did not join the vote. In the end, all 106 PPP lawmakers stayed out of the plenary session and boycotted the ballot. Only 178 lawmakers from the Democratic Party, the Rebuilding Korea Party, and the Reform Party, among others, took part in the vote. <<> Speaker Woo eventually declared at around 4:04 PM that the vote on the amendment was invalid due to a lack of quorum. Passage of a constitutional amendment in the plenary requires approval from at least two-thirds (191 out of 286) of all sitting lawmakers. Previously, on the 3rd of last month, six parties excluding the PPP—the Democratic Party, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—jointly proposed an amendment containing provisions such as: introducing National Assembly approval for the president's declaration of martial law, upgrading the Assembly's right to request the lifting of martial law to a right to lift it, enshrining the spirit of the Busan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the Constitution, and specifying a duty for balanced regional development. <<> After the vote was invalidated, Speaker Woo and the presidential office, among others, expressed strong regret. Speaker Woo said, "If we cannot amend the Constitution even after enduring the insurrection of illegal martial law that plunged the entire nation into suffering, that would be truly shameful." Democratic Party Spokesperson Park Ji-hye criticized in a commentary, "A historic task that has even garnered public consensus has been blocked by the PPP's tantrums." Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Kang Yu-jung stated in a briefing, "We express deep regret and disappointment that the vote was invalidated due to lawmakers' refusal to vote." <<> Speaker Woo announced, "I will reconvene the plenary session on the 8th (for a revote on the amendment)." However, the PPP issued a statement proposing, "Let the ruling and opposition parties form a special committee on constitutional revision in the second half of the 22nd National Assembly to discuss the amendment." For a national referendum on the amendment to be held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, the amendment must pass through the National Assembly by the 10th. If the PPP again boycotts the vote on the 8th, the push for constitutional revision is expected to effectively collapse. <<> Reporters Go Han-sol and Jeong Hye-min sol@hani.co.kr (대한민국헌법 개정안(개헌안)이 7일 국회 본회의에 상정됐지만 국민의힘이 표결에 불참하며 의결정족수 미달로 표결 자체가 이뤄지지 못했다. 우원식 국회의장은 8일 다시 본회의를 열어 개헌안을 재표결하겠다고 밝혔지만 국민의힘이 “졸속 누더기 개헌”이라며 표결 불참을 고수하고 있어 6·3 지방선거 개헌안 국민투표는 사실상 어려워졌다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Second-in-command at Anti-Corruption Commission, Who Led ‘Leniency for Kim Keon-hee’, Discussed Case with Yoon Seok-yeol ([단독] ‘김건희 봐주기’ 앞장 권익위 2인자, 윤석열 만나 사건 논의 정황)
item.description:
In June 2024, before the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) closed the case of First Lady Kim Keon-hee receiving luxury bags with a finding of ‘no violation of the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act,’ circumstantial evidence emerged of a secret meeting between then-President Yoon Seok-yeol and then-ACRC Vice Chairperson and Secretary General Jeong Seung-yoon at the presidential residence. This offers clues to interpret the ACRC’s blatant leniency in its investigation at the time. The background of how the case involving the President’s wife—an apparent acceptance of bribes—was closed, leading the responsible official to take his own life, is expected to be revealed through a police investigation. <<> Under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, the ACRC investigated Kim Keon-hee’s receipt of a Dior bag for violating the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act, but closed the case after 116 days, far exceeding the statutory 90-day processing period. At the time, Vice Chairperson Jeong stated, ‘There are no sanctions against spouses of public officials,’ and ‘We discussed whether it was related to the President’s duties but decided to close it.’ Critics said the commission effectively granted immunity to the presidential couple under political pressure. <<> According to the investigation results of the ‘ACRC Normalization Promotion Task Force (TF),’ which reexamined the handling of the ‘Kim Keon-hee Bag Receipt Case’ released on the 7th, it was confirmed that Vice Chairperson Jeong, who had met with President Yoon, convened an informal meeting with ACRC political appointees and standing commissioners two hours before the full commission meeting on June 10, 2024, to decide the case, and mentioned ‘case closure’ as the direction instead of referral to investigative agencies. The TF determined that ‘the Secretary General (former Vice Chairperson Jeong) limited the review authority of the full commission members, ignored the opinions and procedures of the responsible department, and may have violated the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act in the process of unofficial contact with the accused (former President Yoon Seok-yeol, etc.).’ In other words, the TF’s investigation revealed circumstances suggesting that former Vice Chairperson Jeong met with former President Yoon to discuss the case’s handling direction and actually exerted influence to close it. <<> After the ACRC closed the case of the Dior bag received by First Lady Kim from Pastor Choi Jae-young, the Seoul Central District Prosecutors’ Office decided not to indict both Kim and Choi in October 2024. However, the Kim Keon-hee Special Counsel later indicted Kim and Choi in December last year on charges of mediation bribery under the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Economic Crimes. While the ACRC and prosecution conducted blatantly obstructive investigations, the special counsel acknowledged the exchange of benefits in the luxury bag case and brought them to court. <<> The TF also found evidence of workplace harassment by former Vice Chairperson Jeong against the late former ACRC Bureau Director for Anti-Corruption, Kim (name redacted), who had opposed closing the case. Kim, the official in charge of this case, was found dead at his home in Sejong City on August 8, 2024, two months after the case was closed. From nine days before until a day before his death, he left messages in the form of a will using KakaoTalk’s ‘Chat with Myself’ feature. Disagreeing with the ACRC’s decision to close the case, he reportedly expressed his moral responsibility and self-reproach as the then-responsible official and anti-corruption expert, telling his family, ‘I never expected the case to be closed.’ The ACRC has decided to apologize to the late Kim and his family. <<> Former Vice Chairperson Jeong, a former prosecutor, is a junior at Seoul National University’s law school to former President Yoon Seok-yeol. He worked together with former President Yoon’s campaign in the 20th presidential election and later in the presidential transition committee after his election. Consequently, even at the time of his appointment as vice chairperson, he faced criticism as unsuitable for a leadership role at the ACRC, which is tasked with monitoring public official corruption. Currently a professor at Pusan National University’s Law School, former Vice Chairperson Jeong has announced his intention to run for Busan Superintendent of Education in the June 3 local elections. <<> The Hankyoreh attempted to contact former Vice Chairperson Jeong multiple times to hear his position but received no response. <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (2024년 6월 국민권익위원회(권익위)가 김건희 여사의 명품가방 수수 사건을 ‘청탁금지법 위반 사항 없음’으로 종결 처리하기 전, 윤석열 당시 대통령과 정승윤 당시 권익위 부위원장 겸 사무처장이 대통령 관저에서 은밀히 만난 정황이 드러난 건 당시 권익위의 노골적인 봐주기 조사를 해석할 수 있는 단초를 제공한다. 대통령 부인의 명백한 대가성 금품 수수 사건이 종결되고 담당 실무자가 스스로 목숨을 끊게 된 배경이 경찰 수사를 통해 드러날 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: [6.3 Key Issue Spotlight] Why the Oh Se-hoon–Jeong Won-oh 'Villa Debate'? + Oh Se-hoon's Supply Pledge Today ([6·3 쟁점 돋보기] 오세훈-정원오 ‘빌라 논쟁’ 왜?+오세훈 오늘 공급 공약)
item.description:
Ahead of the June 3 local elections, the housing supply issue has emerged as a core point of contention in the Seoul mayoral race, with People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon and Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh clashing head-on over whether to prioritize 'apartments or villas.' While it appears outwardly to be a debate over housing types, it actually reflects differing approaches on how and at what speed to resolve Seoul's supply shortage. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 서울시장 선거의 핵심 쟁점으로 부동산 공급 문제가 떠오른 가운데, 오세훈 국민의힘 후보와 정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 ‘아파트냐 빌라냐’를 두고 정면으로 충돌하고 있다. 겉으로는 주택 유형을 둘러싼 논쟁처럼 보이지만, 실제로는 서울의 공급 부족 문제를 어떤 방식과 속도로 해결할 것인지에 대한 접근법 차이가 깔렸다.)

The 'villa debate' kicked off in earnest when candidate Jeong said at a meeting of Democratic Party Seoul district office candidates on the 4th, "Apartment redevelopment and reconstruction take 10 to 15 years, but we can devise measures for the jeonse (key-money deposit) and monthly rent issue within two to three years and also supply housing." Jeong had also stated during the announcement of his 'Chak Chak Development' housing supply policy on the 29th of last month that the supply of both apartments and villas in Seoul had sharply declined under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, adding, "We plan to quickly supply small houses and officetels in the city center to revitalize the small housing construction market." <<> In response, candidate Oh's camp has been leveling criticism day after day. Oh's spokesperson, Lee Jong-cheol, argued on the 7th, "It is not a solution to ignore apartment supply, which is the starting point of the problem, and tell citizens looking for jeonse and monthly rental homes to live in villas instead of apartments." <<> However, a closer look at the actual policy content put forward by the two candidates suggests that the issue is less about a simple 'apartment vs. villa' dichotomy and more about differences in the timing and method of supply. While candidate Oh focuses on long-term supply expansion through redevelopment and reconstruction, candidate Jeong's plan is closer to quickly injecting supply into the jeonse and monthly rental market in the short term by utilizing non-apartment units and purchased rental housing, given the prolonged nature of redevelopment projects. <<> Candidate Jeong's policy of expanding non-apartment and purchased rental housing has the advantage of being able to supply jeonse and monthly rental units relatively quickly, as it involves purchasing existing homes. This is seen as a realistic means of achieving short-term supply effects in a situation where redevelopment projects are delayed. On the other hand, the villa market is an area where problems such as jeonse fraud, high jeonse-to-price ratios, and poor housing quality have accumulated, and there are concerns that simply expanding supply without restoring market trust could limit the policy's effectiveness. The inevitable large-scale fiscal investment required to expand purchased rental housing is also cited as a challenge. <<> The strength of candidate Oh's pledges lies in securing a massive supply volume. In the housing supply plan announced today, Oh set a target of starting construction on 310,000 units by 2031. In particular, he stated that 85 zones with 85,000 units that could start construction within three years would be designated as 'Core Strategic Redevelopment Zones' and managed intensively. To accelerate the redevelopment process, he also unveiled a plan to introduce a 'fast-track integration' method that omits the formation of a promotion committee and processes the project implementation plan and management disposition plan simultaneously. <<> However, given the nature of redevelopment projects, actual occupancy is likely to take five to ten years or more, and issues such as tenant relocation and gentrification are also raised. There are assessments that the omission of the promotion committee and the integration of permitting procedures will also need to be monitored to see how much time they can actually save, given the complex interests at each stage of a redevelopment project. <<> Shin Hyung-chul, reporter newiron@hani.co.kr (‘빌라 논쟁’은 정 후보가 지난 4일 민주당 서울 구청장 후보 간담회에서 “아파트 재개발·재건축은 10~15년이 걸리지만 전월세 문제는 2~3년이면 대책을 세울 수 있고 공급도 할 수 있다”고 말하면서 본격화됐다. 정 후보는 지난달 29일 부동산 공급 정책인 ‘착착개발’을 발표하는 자리에서도 윤석열 정부 때 서울의 아파트·빌라 공급 물량이 급격히 줄었다며 “도심 내 빌라·오피스텔을 신속히 공급해 소형주택 건축 시장도 활성화할 계획”이라고 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: "We Will Carefully Attend to the Lives of Parents… Continuously Expand Substantial Support" (이 대통령 “부모님들 삶 세심히 보살필 것…실질적 지원 거듭 확대”)
item.description:
On Parents' Day (May 8), President Lee Jae-myung stated, "We will more carefully and attentively look after the lives of our parents and keep expanding substantial support." (이재명 대통령이 어버이날인 8일 “부모님들의 삶을 더욱 세심하고 살뜰하게 보살피며, 실질적인 지원을 거듭 확대해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

The President made this announcement in a Facebook post titled "To the Parents Who Willingly Embraced the World of Their Children." He expressed, "To all the parents in this country who have devoted themselves to their families and the nation, I offer my deepest respect and gratitude. A parent carries as many worlds as the number of their children. This is something I came to truly realize only after becoming a father of two." (이 대통령은 이날 ‘자식이라는 세계를 기꺼이 품어온 부모님들께’란 제목의 페이스북 글에서 이렇게 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “가정과 국가를 위해 헌신하고 계신 이 땅의 모든 부모님께 깊은 존경과 감사의 인사를 드린다”며 “한 사람의 부모는 자식 숫자만큼의 세상을 짊어지고 살아간다. 두 아이의 아버지가 되고서야 비로소 실감하는 일”이라고 했다.)

President Lee said, "The earnest desire to pass on a better world than the present to our beloved children is the root of this nation and the driving force behind its prosperity and growth. The more we lighten the burden of life resting on our parents' shoulders, the closer the Republic of Korea will move step by step toward becoming a genuine advanced country." He added, "The birth and care of a child should blossom into complete joy. Parents who have devoted a lifetime should be able to enjoy a happy old age without worry. Only then can everyone affirm their lives tomorrow and dream of a better future." (이 대통령은 “사랑하는 내 자식들에게 지금보다 더 나은 세상을 물려주고자 했던 간절한 마음은 이 나라의 뿌리이자, 번영과 성장의 원동력”이라며 “부모님의 어깨 위에 놓인 삶의 무게를 덜어드릴수록, 대한민국이 진정한 선진국을 향해 한 발 한 발 나아갈 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “한 아이의 탄생과 돌봄이 온전한 기쁨으로 꽃피울 수 있어야 한다. 한평생을 헌신한 부모님들이 걱정 없이 행복한 노후를 누릴 수 있어야 한다”며 “그래야 모두가 내일의 삶을 긍정하며 더 나은 미래를 꿈꿀 수 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee added, "The People's Sovereignty Government is preparing institutional measures to ensure a healthy and active old age, including 'integrated community care,' 'dementia-safe property management services,' a record 1.15 million senior job positions, and improvements to the irrational pension system." He concluded, "We will move forward not as a society relying on the unilateral sacrifices of parents, but toward a 'nation where the people are happy,' with the country and community sharing responsibility." (이 대통령은 “국민주권정부는 ‘지역사회 통합 돌봄’, ‘치매안심재산 관리 서비스’, 역대 최대 규모인 ‘115만개의 노인 일자리’, 불합리한 연금 제도 개선 등 건강하고 활기찬 노후를 보장할 제도적 방안을 마련하고 있다”며 “부모의 일방적 희생에 기대는 사회가 아니라, 국가와 공동체가 함께 책임지는 ‘국민이 행복한 나라’로 나아가겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae says "monitoring closely and responding calmly" to U.S. ruling that '10% tariff' is unlawful (청와대, 미 ‘10% 관세’ 위법 판결에 “예의주시하며 차분히 대응”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae said on the 8th regarding the U.S. district court's ruling that the 'global 10% tariff,' which President Donald Trump had invoked to replace reciprocal tariffs, was unlawful, that it plans to "continue to closely monitor related developments and respond calmly in accordance with the principle of securing a balance of benefits under our existing tariff agreement." <<> The U.S. Court of International Trade ruled on the 7th (local time) that the 10% global tariff, newly imposed by the Trump administration on all trading partners worldwide under Section 122 of the Trade Act, is invalid because it violates the law. The court also ordered the refund of tariffs already paid by the plaintiff companies, plus interest. However, the order to halt tariff collection was limited to the two companies that filed the lawsuit and the state of Washington. <<> Cheong Wa Dae stated, "This ruling is a first-instance judgment in the lawsuit filed in the U.S. in early March regarding the Section 122 tariff under the Trade Act, and we understand that the ruling's effect is limited only to some of the plaintiffs." Cheong Wa Dae views that since this ruling is a first-instance decision with effect only on some plaintiffs, it does not shake the overall framework of the U.S.-Korea tariff negotiations. <<> Earlier, after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in February that reciprocal tariffs based on the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were unlawful, President Trump imposed a 10% global tariff on all countries under Section 122 of the Trade Act. Small and medium-sized U.S. companies, such as the spice importer Burlap & Barrel, opposed this and filed a lawsuit in the U.S. Court of International Trade in March. More than 20 states, including Oregon, also filed similar lawsuits against the Trump administration, but the court dismissed most claims on the grounds that the other states, excluding Washington, lacked standing to sue. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (청와대가 8일 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 상호관세를 대체하기 위해 동원한 ‘글로벌 10% 관세’를 미국 1심 법원이 위법하다고 판단한 데 대해 “관련 동향을 지속적으로 예의주시하면서 우리 기존 관세 합의에 따른 이익균형 확보라는 원칙 하에 차분히 대응해 나갈 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)
